mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.customer_id, c.product_id, c.quantity, p.name AS product_name, p.price, p.image, p.stock, b.name AS brand_name FROM cart c JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN brand b ON p.brand_id = b.id WHERE c.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY c.id DESC
SELECT * FROM cart WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND product_id = #{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart(customer_id, product_id, quantity) VALUES (#{customerId}, #{productId}, #{quantity})
mapper.update: UPDATE cart SET quantity = #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id}
